overview: The committee approved the performance evaluation of the Interim Superintendent, elected its 2026 officers, and reviewed the proposed educational plan for the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss collective bargaining with Teamsters Local 25 custodians and pending litigation.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine items including budget transfers, a $1,000 donation from Tufts University, and meeting minutes from January 5, 2026.

items.title: Youth Behavior Risk Survey Summary
items.summary: Received a report on Spring 2025 survey data regarding student mental health, substance use, and emerging trends in sports betting and online gambling.

items.title: Medford High School Educational Plan
items.summary: Discussed the draft educational plan for the high school building project, which prioritizes integrated academics, expanded vocational programming, and co-locating the Curtis Tufts program.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Evaluation
items.summary: Approved the performance evaluation for Dr. Suzanne Galusi, which reflected proficient to exemplary ratings across all state standards for her first year of leadership.

items.title: Election of School Committee Officers
items.summary: Elected Breanna Lungo-Koehn as Chair, Jenny Graham as Vice Chair, and Paul Ruseau as Secretary for the 2026 term.

items.title: Board and Subcommittee Appointments
items.summary: Appointed Paul Ruseau to the Shore Educational Collaborative Board and approved the chair and membership assignments for all standing subcommittees.

items.title: Resolutions Regarding Permanent Superintendent Appointment
items.summary: Approved resolutions to compile community feedback on district leadership and to determine the process for appointing a permanent superintendent during the February 2 meeting.
